adjudication.rationale: The diff moves membership mutation out of `Admin::GroupsController#update` (now only sets `alias_level`, `visible`, and `name`; no `usernames`/`changes` handling) and into new endpoints `add_members`/`remove_member` (see `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb`). In the spec, the prior `.update` membership tests (including the “incremental” add/delete/nonexistent/no-op cases) were deleted, and the new `.add_members`/`.remove_member` contexts only cover adding several users and removing an existing member, plus automatic-group rejection, but do not re-home the old edge-case behaviors. There is also no regression test asserting that passing legacy membership params to PUT `#update` no longer changes membership.
